title: StepEnvelope
description: Individual step definition within a Tracto automation script.

stepId.description: Unique step identifier within the automation. Lowercase, starts with a letter.

action.description: Fully qualified action name in namespace.action format (e.g. desktop.click, service.invoke).

inputs.description: Map of input parameter names to typed values or references.

outputBinding.description: Map of declared var name to step output field reference (e.g. steps.<stepId>.outputs.<field>).

timeoutMs.description: Maximum milliseconds this step may execute before TimedOut is raised.

retryClass.description: Retry classification governing whether and how this step may be retried on failure.

precondition.description: Technical condition that must be true before the step executes.

postcondition.description: Technical condition that must be true after the step completes to verify effect commitment.

onFailure.description: Handler invoked when this step reaches a terminal failure state.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity classification for this step's inputs/outputs. Affects telemetry redaction.

ref.description: Reference path to an input, var, step output, or secret.

TypedValue.description: A literal typed value or a reference to a declared binding.

TechnicalCondition.description: A technical predicate evaluated by the worker runtime. Must not encode business intent (see contract §ST1-04-AC06).

predicate.description: Fully qualified predicate name in namespace.predicate format (e.g. desktop.elementExists, api.statusCodeEquals).

args.description: Arguments passed to the predicate evaluator.

waitMs.description: Maximum milliseconds to poll for this condition to become true. Zero means evaluate once.

pollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval in milliseconds when waitMs > 0.

OnFailureHandler.description: Specifies what happens when this step reaches a terminal failure state.

handler.description: Named failure handler strategy (e.g. abort, continueWithDefault, escalate).

compensatingSteps.description: Ordered list of stepIds to execute as compensating actions before the handler runs.
